description: Deterministically resolve a folder, list eligible (CONVERTED) videos, estimate the dubbing cost in credits, and optionally create AI dubbing jobs for one or more target languages. dry_run=true (default) returns a preview without creating any job. standard mode = 2 credits/min, lipsync = 10 credits/min (lipsync rejects videos over 60 minutes).

dry_run.description: true = preview only; false = create jobs

folder_ref.description: Folder name, ID, or dashboard URL

idempotency_key.description: Reserved client-supplied key to make retries safe (not yet enforced server-side)

target_langs.description: Target language codes to dub into, e.g. ['en','es']

name: panda_action_dub_folder_videos
title: Dub Folder Videos
